query.commandtext: INSERT INTO ?? (ID , X , Y , ?? , ?? , ?? , ??) SELECT B.WAFER_ID , A.X , A.Y , A.BIN , DECODE(A.BIN, 1, 'T','F') , A.VISUALINSP , DECODE(A.VISUALINSP, 0, 'T','F') FROM ?? A, TQP_WAFER_SUM B WHERE 1=1 AND A.WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND A.WAFER_SEQ = B.WAFER_SEQ

MERGE INTO ?? A USING ( SELECT B.LOT_ID , B.WAFER_ID , A.X , A.Y , A.BIN , DECODE(A.BIN, 1, 'T','F') AS HIGH_GEC , A.VISUALINSP , DECODE(A.VISUALINSP, 0, 'T','F') AS VISUAL_GEC FROM ?? A, TQP_WAFER_SUM B WHERE 1=1 AND A.WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND A.WAFER_SEQ = B.WAFER_SEQ ) B ON (A.ID = B.WAFER_ID AND A.X = B.X AND A.Y = B.Y) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.?? = B.BIN , A.?? = B.HIGH_GEC , A.?? = B.VISUALINSP , A.?? = B.VISUAL_GEC

INSERT INTO ?? (ID , X , Y , ?? , ?? , ?? , ??) SELECT C.LOT_ID || '.' || C.WAFER_ID --ID , ( B.X - C.MIN_X +1) X --X , (C.MAX_Y - B.Y +1 ) Y --Y , DECODE(A.BIN, null, 1, A.BIN) AS BIN --BIN , DECODE(A.BIN, null, 'T','F') HIGH_GEC --BIN_GEC , B.VISUALINSP AS VI --VI , DECODE(B.VISUALINSP, 0, 'T', 'F') AS VI_GEC --VI_GEC FROM ( SELECT XINDEX AS X, YINDEX AS Y, MAX(CLASSNUMBER) AS BIN FROM ( SELECT STEP_SEQ, RESULTTIMESTAMP, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC) AS RANK FROM TQD_LOT A, TQD_WAFER B, TQD_STEP C WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.PRODUCT = :product AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND B.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = C.WAFER_SEQ AND C.STEP_ID = :step_id ) A, TQD_DEFECT B WHERE A.RANK = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ GROUP BY XINDEX, YINDEX ) A, ( SELECT INDEX_X AS X, INDEX_Y AS Y, VISUALINSP FROM ( SELECT STEP_SEQ, RESULTTIMESTAMP, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC) AS RANK FROM TQD_LOT A, TQD_WAFER B, TQD_STEP C WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.PRODUCT = :product AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND B.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = C.WAFER_SEQ AND C.STEP_ID = :step_id ) A, TQD_SCAN_SAMPLE B WHERE A.RANK = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ ) B, ( SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID , MAX(INDEX_X) MAX_X, MAX(INDEX_Y) MAX_Y , MIN(INDEX_X) MIN_X, MIN(INDEX_Y) MIN_Y FROM ( SELECT A.LOT_ID , B.WAFER_ID , STEP_SEQ , RESULTTIMESTAMP , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC) AS RANK FROM TQD_LOT A, TQD_WAFER B, TQD_STEP C WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.PRODUCT = :product AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND B.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = C.WAFER_SEQ AND C.STEP_ID = :step_id ) A, TQD_SCAN_SAMPLE B WHERE A.RANK = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ GROUP BY A.LOT_ID, A.WAFER_ID ) C WHERE 1=1 AND A.X (+)= B.X AND A.Y (+)= B.Y

MERGE INTO ?? A USING (SELECT C.LOT_ID -- LOT_ID , C.WAFER_ID --WAFER_ID , ( B.X - C.MIN_X +1) X --X , (C.MAX_Y - B.Y +1 ) Y --Y , DECODE(A.BIN, null, 1, A.BIN) AS BIN -- BIN , DECODE(A.BIN, null, 'T','F') HIGH_GEC -- BIN_GEC , B.VISUALINSP AS VISUALINSP -- VI , DECODE(B.VISUALINSP, 0, 'T', 'F') AS VISUAL_GEC -- VI_GEC FROM ( SELECT XINDEX AS X, YINDEX AS Y, MAX(CLASSNUMBER) AS BIN FROM ( SELECT STEP_SEQ, RESULTTIMESTAMP , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC) AS RANK FROM TQD_LOT A, TQD_WAFER B, TQD_STEP C WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.PRODUCT = :product AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND B.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = C.WAFER_SEQ AND C.STEP_ID = :step_id ) A, TQD_DEFECT B WHERE A.RANK = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ GROUP BY XINDEX, YINDEX ) A, ( SELECT INDEX_X AS X, INDEX_Y AS Y, VISUALINSP FROM ( SELECT STEP_SEQ, RESULTTIMESTAMP , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC) AS RANK FROM TQD_LOT A, TQD_WAFER B, TQD_STEP C WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.PRODUCT = :product AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND B.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = C.WAFER_SEQ AND C.STEP_ID = :step_id ) A, TQD_SCAN_SAMPLE B WHERE A.RANK = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ ) B, ( SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID , MAX(INDEX_X) MAX_X, MAX(INDEX_Y) MAX_Y , MIN(INDEX_X) MIN_X, MIN(INDEX_Y) MIN_Y FROM ( SELECT A.LOT_ID , B.WAFER_ID , STEP_SEQ , RESULTTIMESTAMP , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC) AS RANK FROM TQD_LOT A, TQD_WAFER B, TQD_STEP C WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.PRODUCT = :product AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND B.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = C.WAFER_SEQ AND C.STEP_ID = :step_id ) A, TQD_SCAN_SAMPLE B WHERE A.RANK = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ GROUP BY A.LOT_ID, A.WAFER_ID ) C WHERE 1=1 AND A.X (+)= B.X AND A.Y (+)= B.Y ) B ON (A.ID = B.LOT_ID || '.' ||B.WAFER_ID AND A.X = B.X AND A.Y = B.Y) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.?? = B.BIN, A.?? = B.HIGH_GEC, A.?? = B.VISUALINSP, A.?? = B.VISUAL_GEC
SELECT X ,Y , CASE ?? END AS BIN , CASE ?? END AS GEC , CASE ?? END AS VISUALINSP , CASE ?? END AS VISUALAINSP_GEC , 1 AS USECODE FROM ?? WHERE ID = :id ORDER BY Y,X

SELECT (C.MAX_X - B.X +1 ) X --X , (C.MAX_Y - B.Y +1) Y --Y , DECODE(A.BIN, null, 1, A.BIN) AS BIN --BIN , DECODE(A.BIN, null, 'T','F') HIGH_GEC --BIN_GEC , B.VISUALINSP AS VI --VI , '1' AS USECODE FROM ( SELECT XINDEX AS X, YINDEX AS Y, MAX(CLASSNUMBER) AS BIN FROM ( SELECT STEP_SEQ, RESULTTIMESTAMP, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC) AS RANK FROM TQD_LOT A, TQD_WAFER B, TQD_STEP C WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.PRODUCT = :product AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND B.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = C.WAFER_SEQ AND C.STEP_ID = :step_id ) A, TQD_DEFECT B WHERE A.RANK = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ GROUP BY XINDEX, YINDEX ) A, ( SELECT INDEX_X AS X, INDEX_Y AS Y, VISUALINSP FROM ( SELECT STEP_SEQ, RESULTTIMESTAMP, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC) AS RANK FROM T_DMS_LOT A, T_DMS_WAFER B, T_DMS_STEP C WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.PRODUCT = :product AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND B.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = C.WAFER_SEQ AND C.STEP_ID = :step_id ) A, T_DMS_SCAN_SAMPLE B WHERE A.RANK = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ ) B, ( SELECT LOT_ID, WAFER_ID , MAX(INDEX_X) MAX_X, MAX(INDEX_Y) MAX_Y , MIN(INDEX_X) MIN_X, MIN(INDEX_Y) MIN_Y FROM ( SELECT A.LOT_ID , B.WAFER_ID , STEP_SEQ , RESULTTIMESTAMP , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC) AS RANK FROM T_DMS_LOT A, T_DMS_WAFER B, T_DMS_STEP C WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.PRODUCT = :product AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND B.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = C.WAFER_SEQ AND C.STEP_ID = :step_id ) A, T_DMS_SCAN_SAMPLE B WHERE A.RANK = 1 AND A.STEP_SEQ = B.STEP_SEQ GROUP BY A.LOT_ID, A.WAFER_ID ) C WHERE 1=1 AND A.X (+)= B.X AND A.Y (+)= B.Y

SELECT STEP_SEQ FROM ( SELECT STEP_SEQ, RESULTTIMESTAMP, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY RESULTTIMESTAMP DESC) AS RANK FROM TQD_LOT A, TQD_WAFER B, TQD_STEP C WHERE 1=1 AND A.LOT_ID = :lot_id AND A.PRODUCT = :product AND A.LOT_SEQ = B.LOT_SEQ AND B.WAFER_ID = :wafer_id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = C.WAFER_SEQ AND C.STEP_ID = :step_id ) WHERE RANK = 1

SELECT A.X ,A.Y , CASE ?? WHEN VISUALINSP != '0' THEN VISUALINSP ELSE 0 END AS VI , CASE ?? END AS BIN , 1 AS USECODE FROM ?? A, ?? B WHERE ID = :id AND B.WAFER_SEQ = :wafer_seq AND A.X = B.X AND A.Y = B.Y ORDER BY Y,X
CREATE TABLE ?? ( ID VarChar(100 BYTE) NOT NULL, X NUMBER(3) NOT NULL, Y NUMBER(3) NOT NULL, ?? )
